knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation. A fees page quotes a 1 USD minimum fee against a 25,000 USD transfer — four and a half orders of magnitude, and both are prices the reader actually cares about. The median grid lands on three decimals, so the 1 USD fee renders as "0.001 ZEC" with one significant figure while 25,000 USD keeps four as "32.05 ZEC". Holding the transfer to the grid would print "32.051 ZEC", a fifth significant figure the held rate cannot support. Every amount converts correctly; the shape is the only failure.
